Analyze motion from video

Sample motion at regular intervals to create a strobe photo or video.Detect object positions and analyze motion with graphs.

Tips for filming
  • Keep the camera still throughout the recording.
  • Film in good light with an object that stands out from the background.
  • Record a frame with the same view but without the object.
  • Use slow-motion recording for fast-moving objects.

Video processing stays on your device.
